title: OpenAI reportedly ditches model over safety concerns
slides: Why did OpenAI quietly abandon its own model?
Months of work vanished without a public explanation
Internal safety alarms, not capabilities, killed it
Your AI roadmap may depend on secrets you can't see
Ask vendors what they shelved and why
thread_text:
1. The Model They Buried

OpenAI ditched a model after months of work, no announcement, no blog post. The silence is the story.

2. Safety Killed It

Internal alarms — not lack of capability — ended the project. The tech worked, but something spooked the safety team.

3. Your Roadmap Is Blind

If you're building on a vendor's roadmap, you're betting on decisions made in rooms you'll never see. They shelve, you pivot.

4. Ask About the Graveyard

Every AI vendor has a graveyard of abandoned models. Most won't mention it. That silence costs you months.

5. One Email Today

Write to your AI vendor: 'What have you shelved in the last year, and why?' Their answer — or silence — tells you everything.
